name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

source_set.identifier: OWASP Top 10 for LLM became the OWASP GenAI Security Project

versioning_boundary.evaluated_list: 2025 Top 10 Risk & Mitigations for LLMs and Gen AI Apps

allowed_use_boundary: Use as external LLM/GenAI application risk and vulnerability guidance crosswalk evidence.
Preserve OWASP-native risk terminology and distinguish the evaluated 2025 LLM/GenAI list from newer Agentic Top 10 resources.
Use risk categories and mitigations as security-review evidence, not as standing or authority.
Do not treat as certification, endorsement, execution authority, or commit-time authority.
claims: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 can support LLM/GenAI application risk, vulnerability, and mitigation comparison.
OWASP risk categories can be mapped to review posture, evidence posture, governance boundary, drift, output-handling, and fail-closed terms.
The OWASP GenAI Security Project is the current broader project context for the evaluated Top 10 resource.
non_claims: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications does not prove transition admissibility.
OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications does not grant execution authority inside StegVerse.
A mapped OWASP risk or mitigation does not establish actor identity, delegation, standing, or consequence-binding authority.
The StegVerse compatibility fixture is a bounded simulation/crosswalk test and is not an OWASP certification or endorsement.
